arxiv-2011-01941.title: Inhomogeneous time-reversal symmetry breaking in Sr 2 ​ RuO 4 \mathrm{Sr}_{2}\mathrm{Ru}\mathrm{O}_{4}
arxiv-2011-01941.creator: Roland Willa, Matthias Hecker, Rafael M. Fernandes, Jörg Schmalian
arxiv-2011-01941.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Roland Willa, Matthias Hecker, Rafael M. Fernandes, Jörg Schmalian. We show that the observed time-reversal symmetry breaking (TRSB) of the superconducting state in Sr 2 ​ RuO 4 \mathrm{Sr}_{2}\mathrm{Ru}\mathrm{O}_{4} can be understood as originating from inhomogeneous strain fields near edge dislocations of the crystal. Specifically, we argue that, without strain inhomogeneities, Sr 2 ​ RuO 4 \mathrm{Sr}_{2}\mathrm{Ru}\mathrm{O}_{4} is a single-component, time-reversal symmetric superconductor, likely with d x 2 − y 2 d_{x^{2}-y^{2}} symmetry.

arxiv-2106-02848.creator: Sivakanth Gopi, Yin Tat Lee, Lukas Wutschitz
arxiv-2106-02848.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Sivakanth Gopi, Yin Tat Lee, Lukas Wutschitz. We give a fast algorithm to optimally compose privacy guarantees of differentially private (DP) algorithms to arbitrary accuracy. Our method is based on the notion of privacy loss random variables to quantify the privacy loss of DP algorithms. The running time and memory needed for our algorithm to approximate the privacy curve of a DP algorithm composed with itself k k times is O ~ ​ ( k ) \tilde{O}(\sqrt{k}) .

arxiv-2112-09587.title: Symmetry-dependent ultrafast manipulation of nanoscale magnetic domains
arxiv-2112-09587.creator: Nanna Zhou Hagström, Rahul Jangid, Meera, Diego Turenne, Jeffrey Brock, Erik S. Lamb, Boyan Stoychev, Justine Schlappa, Natalia Gerasimova, Benjamin Van Kuiken, Rafael Gort, Laurent Mercadier, Loïc Le Guyader, Andrey Samartsev, Andreas Scherz, Giuseppe Mercurio, Hermann A. Dürr, Alexander H. Reid, M
arxiv-2112-09587.description: Abstract Symmetry is a powerful concept in physics, but its applicability to far-from-equilibrium states is still being understood. Recent attention has focused on how far-from-equilibrium states lead to spontaneous symmetry breaking. Conversely, ultrafast optical pumping can be used to drastically change the energy landscape and quench the magnetic order parameter in magnetic systems.

arxiv-2204-10886.title: Energetics of quantum vacuum friction. II: Dipole fluctuations and field fluctuations
arxiv-2204-10886.creator: Xin Guo ID, Kimball A. Milton ID, Gerard Kennedy ID, William P. McNulty ID, Nima Pourtolami ID, Yang Li ID
arxiv-2204-10886.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Xin Guo ID, Kimball A. Milton ID, Gerard Kennedy ID, William P. McNulty ID, Nima Pourtolami ID, Yang Li ID. Quantum vacuum friction experienced by an atom, where the only dissipative mechanism is through its interaction with the radiation field, has been studied in our recent paper [Phys. D 104 , 116006 (2021)]. Quantum vacuum friction on an intrinsically dissipative particle is different in that the friction arises not only from the field fluctuations but also from the dipole fluctuations intrinsic to the particle.

arxiv-2211-08795.title: Ionization-induced Long-lasting Orientation of Symmetric-top Molecules
arxiv-2211-08795.creator: Long Xu, Ilia Tutunnikov, Yehiam Prior, Ilya Sh. Averbukh
arxiv-2211-08795.description: Abstract We theoretically consider the phenomenon of field-free long-lasting orientation of symmetric-top molecules ionized by two-color laser pulses. The anisotropic ionization produces a significant long-lasting orientation of the surviving neutral molecules. The degree of orientation increases with both the pulse intensity and, counterintuitively, with the rotational temperature. The orientation may be enhanced even further by using multiple delayed two-color pulses.

arxiv-2303-11652.description: Abstract . In this paper, we estimate an operator norm of dilation operators on block spaces ( 𝔅 r , α ​ ( ℚ p ) \mathfrak{B}_{r,\alpha}(\mathbb{Q}_{p}) ) over p p -adic field. With this estimate, we establish boundedness of p p -adic Hardy-Hilbert type integral operator on 𝔅 r , α ​ ( ℚ p ) \mathfrak{B}_{r,\alpha}(\mathbb{Q}_{p}) .

arxiv-2306-08053.title: Quantifying Spatial Audio Quality Impairment
arxiv-2306-08053.creator: Karn N. Watcharasupat, Alexander Lerch
arxiv-2306-08053.description: Abstract Spatial audio quality is a highly multifaceted concept, with many interactions between environmental, geometrical, anatomical, psychological, and contextual considerations. Methods for characterization or evaluation of the geometrical components of spatial audio quality, however, remain scarce, despite being perhaps the least subjective aspect of spatial audio quality to quantify.

arxiv-2307-05367.title: Minimal Lengths in 3D via the Generalized Uncertainty Principle
arxiv-2307-05367.creator: Michael Bishop, Joey Contreras, Peter Martin, Piero Nicolini, Douglas Singleton
arxiv-2307-05367.description: Abstract We investigate an extension of the Generalized Uncertainty Principle (GUP) in three dimensions by modifying the three dimensional position and momentum operators in a manner that remains coordinate-independent and retains as much of the standard position-momentum commutators as possible. Moreover, we bound the physical momentum which leads to an effective minimal length in every coordinate direction.

arxiv-2309-00267.title: RLAIF vs. RLHF: Scaling Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback with AI Feedback
arxiv-2309-00267.creator: Harrison Lee, Samrat Phatale, Hassan Mansoor, Thomas Mesnard, Johan Ferret, Kellie Lu, Colton Bishop, Ethan Hall, Victor Carbune, Abhinav Rastogi, Sushant Prakash
arxiv-2309-00267.description: Abstract Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) has proven effective in aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences, but gathering high-quality preference labels is expensive. RL from AI Feedback (RLAIF), introduced in Bai et al. 2022b , offers a promising alternative that trains the reward model (RM) on preferences generated by an off-the-shelf LLM.

arxiv-2402-10424.title: Understanding In-Context Learning with a Pelican Soup Framework
arxiv-2402-10424.creator: Ting-Rui Chiang, Dani Yogatama
arxiv-2402-10424.description: Abstract Many existing theoretical analyses of in-context learning for natural language processing are based on latent variable models that leaves gaps between theory and practice. We aim to close these gaps by proposing a theoretical framework, the Pelican Soup Framework .

arxiv-2404-04478.title: Diffusion-RWKV : Scaling RWKV-Like Architectures for Diffusion Models
arxiv-2404-04478.creator: Zhengcong Fei, Mingyuan Fan, Changqian Yu
arxiv-2404-04478.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Zhengcong Fei, Mingyuan Fan, Changqian Yu. Transformers have catalyzed advancements in computer vision and natural language processing (NLP) fields. However, substantial computational complexity poses limitations for their application in long-context tasks, such as high-resolution image generation. This paper introduces a series of architectures adapted from the RWKV model used in the NLP, with requisite modifications tailored for diffusion model applied to image generation tasks, referred to as Diffusion-RWKV.

arxiv-2503-09040.title: Motion-Blender Gaussian Splatting for Dynamic Scene Reconstruction
arxiv-2503-09040.creator: Xinyu Zhang, Haonan Chang, Yuhan Liu, Abdeslam Boularias
arxiv-2503-09040.description: Abstract Gaussian splatting has emerged as a powerful tool for high-fidelity reconstruction of dynamic scenes. However, existing methods primarily rely on implicit motion representations, such as encoding motions into neural networks or per-Gaussian parameters, which makes it difficult to further manipulate the reconstructed motions.

arxiv-2504-05964.title: Context-aware Rate Adaptation for Predictive Flying Networks using Contextual Bandits Thanks: This work is financed by National Funds through the Portuguese funding agency, FCT - Fundação para a Ciência e Tecnologia, under the PhD grant 2022.10093.BD, by the NII MoU grant between NII and INESC TEC,
arxiv-2504-05964.creator: Ruben Queiros 1 , Megumi Kaneko 2 , Helder Fontes 1 , Rui Campos 1
arxiv-2504-05964.description: Abstract The increasing complexity of wireless technologies, such as Wi-Fi, presents significant challenges for Rate Adaptation (RA) due to the large configuration space of transmission parameters. While extensive research has been conducted on RA for low-mobility networks, existing solutions fail to adapt in flying networks, where high mobility and dynamic wireless conditions introduce additional uncertainty.

arxiv-2506-18069.title: Unfolding the Past: A Comprehensive Deep Learning Approach to Analyzing Incunabula Pages
arxiv-2506-18069.creator: Klaudia Ropel, Krzysztof Kutt, Luiz do Valle Miranda, Grzegorz J. Nalepa
arxiv-2506-18069.description: Abstract We developed a proof-of-concept method for the automatic analysis of the structure and content of incunabula pages. A custom dataset comprising 500 annotated pages from five different incunabula was created using resources from the Jagiellonian Digital Library. Each page was manually labeled with five predefined classes: Text, Title, Picture, Table, and Handwriting.

arxiv-2510-07125.title: Preparation of initial states with open and periodic boundary conditions on quantum devices using matrix product states
arxiv-2510-07125.creator: Yibin Guo, Manuel Schneider, Takis Angelides, Karl Jansen, C.-J. David Lin, Yao Ting Su
arxiv-2510-07125.description: Abstract We present a framework for preparing quantum states from matrix product states (MPS) with open and periodic boundary conditions on quantum devices. The MPS tensors are mapped to unitary gates, which are subsequently decomposed into native gates on quantum hardware.

arxiv-2510-12383.title: Towards Cross-Modal Error Detection with Tables and Images
arxiv-2510-12383.creator: Olga Ovcharenko, Sebastian Schelter
arxiv-2510-12383.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Olga Ovcharenko, Sebastian Schelter. Ensuring data quality at scale remains a persistent challenge for large organizations. Despite recent advances, maintaining accurate and consistent data is still complex, especially when dealing with multiple data modalities. Traditional error detection and correction methods tend to focus on a single modality, typically a table, and often miss cross-modal errors that are common in domains like e-Commerce and healthcare, where image, tabular, and text data co-exist.

arxiv-2601-04424.title: Gavel : Agent Meets Checklist for Evaluating LLMs on Long-Context Legal Summarization
arxiv-2601-04424.creator: Yao Dou, Wei Xu
arxiv-2601-04424.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) now support contexts of up to 1M tokens, but their effectiveness on complex long-context tasks remains unclear. In this paper, we study multi-document legal case summarization, where a single case often spans many documents totaling 100K–500K tokens.

With approximately 5 billion mobile phone users globally, opportunities for mobile technologies to play a for

plos-pone-0010866.creator: Nicholas Chia, Isaac Cann, Gary J. Olsen
plos-pone-0010866.description: PLOS ONE research article. The replication of DNA in Archaea and eukaryotes requires several ancillary complexes, including proliferating cell nuclear antigen (PCNA), replication factor C (RFC), and the minichromosome maintenance (MCM) complex. pmc-10648605.title: Management of Hypertension in Diabetic Kidney Disease
pmc-10648605.creator: Gates B Colbert, Mohamed E Elrggal, Anna Gaddy, Hector M Madariaga, Edgar V Lerma, Christos Argyropoulos, Radica Alicic
pmc-10648605.description: Hypertension is a critical component of cardiovascular disease progression in patients with chronic kidney disease, and specifically diabetic kidney disease (DKD). Causation versus correlation remains up for debate, but what has been confirmed is the delay of DKD progression when hypertension is controlled or moved to guideline drive ranges.

pmc-11389468.title: Informing future randomized controlled trials of amantadine hydrochloride in neurocritical care and post-neurocritical care stroke patients through a retrospective study
pmc-11389468.creator: Enzo G Plaitano, Rebecca A Scharf, Pakinam E Aboutaleb, Andrea L Glennon, Emiliya Melkumova, Deborah M Green-LaRoche
pmc-11389468.description: BackgroundAmantadine hydrochloride has been increasingly prescribed as a neurostimulant for neurocritical care stroke patients to promote wakefulness during inpatient recovery. However, a lack of guidelines makes it difficult to decide who may benefit from this pharmacotherapy and when amantadine should be initiated during the hospital stay.

pmc-11482002.title: A Case of Refractory Thyroid Storm Despite Correction of Peripheral Thyroid Hormone Levels
pmc-11482002.creator: Madeline Evans, Grace Prince, Priyanka Majety
pmc-11482002.description: Thyroid storm is a life-threatening complication of hyperthyroidism that necessitates early diagnosis for aggressive, effective treatment. We present a patient with a newly diagnosed multinodular goiter who presented to the emergency department with leg swelling, dyspnea, tremors, and atrial fibrillation with elevation in thyroid hormone levels consistent with thyrotoxicosis.

pmc-11625128.title: Symptom clusters and symptom networks of symptom experiences in patients with SARS-CoV-2 infection
pmc-11625128.creator: Hongmin Ye, Xiuni Gan, Wen Zhou, Yan Gao, Zhechuan Mei, Qiulan Zheng, Xiaoqing Luo, Chunlan Yuan, Yan Wu
pmc-11625128.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). ContextSymptom clusters and symptom networks can potentially enhance the precision in managing symptoms. However, limited research has been conducted on the symptom network experienced by patients infected with Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2.ObjectivesTo identify the composition of symptom clusters in SARS-CoV-2 infected patients, establish a symptom network to explore the centrality indices, and investigate independent risk factors influencing the occurrence of symptom clusters.MethodsBetween February 2022 and June 2023, a total of 418 patients diagnosed with SARS-CoV-2 infection were recruited in the

pmc-11864486.title: Partial right gonadal vein thrombosis after uterine fibroid embolization
pmc-11864486.creator: Atefeh Kalantary, Sina Shafiei, Anthony R. Tabet, Michael E. Lazarus
pmc-11864486.description: Gonadal vein thrombosis (GVT) is a very rare complication of uterine fibroid embolization. The risk factors for GVT include pregnancy, especially after caesarean-section, oral contraceptive use, underlying malignancy, any pelvic surgery including embolization procedures, pelvic inflammatory disease, inflammatory bowel disease and idiopathic causes.

pmc-12520451.title: Exploration of a pain assessment tool on burning mouth syndrome
pmc-12520451.creator: Takumi Shimura, Tatsuki Itagaki, Ken-ichiro Sakata, Takuya Asaka, Masayuki Shinohara, Sadasuke Hayata, Ikuya Miyamoto
pmc-12520451.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Burning mouth syndrome (BMS) is a chronic orofacial pain disorder. The etiology and pathophysiology of BMS remain unclear; multiple factors may interact in complex ways. There is a need for simpler and more cost-effective BMS evaluation criteria. This study aimed to evaluate the reliability and validity of the Short Form McGill Pain Questionnaire version 2 (SF-MPQ-2) in patients with BMS and develop a subscale based on factor analysis of the results to classify patients per their symptoms.

pmc-12552018.title: Age-Related Variation in the Diameter of the Common Bile Duct and Its Association With Anthropometric Parameters: An Ultrasonographic Study in an Eastern Indian Cohort
pmc-12552018.creator: Suman Hela, Debabrata Maitra
pmc-12552018.description: IntroductionThe common bile duct (CBD) is a key structure in bile transport and lipid digestion, and its diameter is an important parameter for diagnosing biliary pathology. However, normal reference values vary across populations owing to differences in age, body size, sex, and imaging modalities.

pmc-12562963.title: Enhancing the Anti-Aging Potential of Green Tea Extracts Through Liquid-State Fermentation with Aspergillus niger RAF106
pmc-12562963.creator: Yuju Liu, Xiao Zhang, Xingbing Liu, Ruixuan Li, Ximiao Yang, Zhenlin Liao, Xiang Fang, Jie Wang, Biagi Angelo Zullo
pmc-12562963.description: Microbial fermentation diversely modulates the bioactivity of green tea extracts (GTE), but its effects on anti-aging potential remain under-explored. This study investigated the effects of liquid-state fermentation by Aspergillus niger RAF106 on the anti-aging properties of GTE from Biluochun and identified its longevity-promoting metabolites.

pmc-13122135.title: Emotion Expression in Breast Cancer Support Seeking: Empirical Study of an Online Community
pmc-13122135.creator: Anqi Xu, Ahmad Aljanaideh, Jennifer Xu, Haijing Hao
pmc-13122135.description: BackgroundBreast cancer affects millions of women and presents not only medical challenges but also emotional, financial, and social burdens. Beyond clinical treatment, patients increasingly turn to online cancer communities (OCCs) for informational support, emotional support, and shared coping strategies. OCCs help patients manage daily life and reduce psychological distress through shared experiences and empathetic engagement.
